description: Tweets from X (Twitter) for one account or a search query. {"mode":"profile","query":"nasa"} returns that account's tweets, mode search takes keywords, and limit is 1-20. Each tweet has text, createdAt, url, lang, likeCount, retweetCount, replyCount, quoteCount, viewCount, isReply, isRetweet and an author object with userName, name, followers and isBlueVerified. No X developer account needed; pay per call in USDC. Not offered on Solana: pay on Base or Polygon.

limit.description: number of posts wanted, 1 to 20 (default 5). A larger value is lowered to 20 and 0 or a negative one means the default; the quote follows the value used.

name: twitter
title: X (Twitter) tweets by handle or search
